<section class="home-section home-section-soft">

  <div class="home-shell">

        Scientific infrastructure
      </p>

      <h2>
        Built around decisions that remain visible.
      </h2>

      <p>
        The project treats reproducibility as more than saving code. Sources,
        methods, assumptions, validation results, and analytical limitations
        remain part of the final evidence.
      </p>

    </div>

    <div class="home-principle-grid">

      <article class="home-principle">
        <div class="home-principle-number">1</div>
        <h3>Source-aware</h3>
        <p>
          Every file is connected to its survey cycle, component, official URL,
          local path, role, and provenance record.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="home-principle">
        <div class="home-principle-number">2</div>
        <h3>Laboratory-informed</h3>
        <p>
          Methods, instruments, units, specimen conditions, eligibility, and
          detection limits are treated as analytical information.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="home-principle">
        <div class="home-principle-number">3</div>
        <h3>Validation-first</h3>
        <p>
          File structures, variables, keys, duplicates, joins, row counts, and
          outputs are checked before interpretation.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="home-principle">
        <div class="home-principle-number">4</div>
        <h3>Survey-conscious</h3>
        <p>
          Descriptive analysis is distinguished from population inference
          requiring valid weights, strata, PSUs, and design-based methods.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="home-principle">
        <div class="home-principle-number">5</div>
        <h3>Reusable</h3>
        <p>
          Processed datasets, tables, figures, dictionaries, logs, and validation
          outputs are saved in defined project locations.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="home-principle">
        <div class="home-principle-number">6</div>
        <h3>Extensible</h3>
        <p>
          The architecture supports additional laboratory components without
          implying that every NHANES file can use the same generic workflow.
        </p>
      </article>

    </div>

  </div>
